en.hubeali: From him, from his father, from Fazalat Bin Ayoub, from Al Hassan Bin Ziyad Al Sayqal, from Fuzayl Bin Yasaar who said,
‘Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The most difficult of the worship is the devoutness’.
en.sarwar: 5. It is narrated from him (narrator of the Hadith above) from his father from Fadalah ibn Ayyub from al-Hassan ibn Ziyad al-Sayqal from Fudayl ibn Yasar
from abu Ja’far who has said the following: “Abu Ja’far (a.s.) has said, ‘Restraining from worldly matters (sins) is the most intense form of worship.’”
